messages:
Maya: Heads-up: we need a tightly scoped alpha for the Optimize recommendations (batching + caching suggestions, quantization advice, and eval-triggered alerts). Goal: meaningful pilot in 2 sprints. Thoughts?

Raj: 2 sprints is tight but doable if we keep quantization to offline suggestions only (no automatic deployment). Focus: recommender + alert plumbing + minimal console UX.

Lina: Telemetry and eval baselines are hard blockers. We'll need per-customer baselines for mismatch rate, token savings, and latency deltas. Can we require pilot customers to provide a small gold set?

ACME-Beth: ACME can provide 500 prompts + golden outputs and is interested in quant suggestions with expected cost/latency numbers. We prefer manual review before any runtime change.

Mateo: Platform must provide: feature flag opt-in, webhook for alerts, SDK meta for "recommendation seen/accepted" events. I can reuse existing flag infra. ETA: flag + webhook in 1 sprint, SDK events second sprint.

Priya: Console: simple recommendations card + accept/reject buttons, and alert config (threshold, webhook). Mockup will be ready Wed. Keep it to one new tile to reduce frontend scope.

Jorge: Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) <3% eval degradation on customer gold set, 2) p95 latency change <= +25ms, 3) tokens_saved >= 10% on batched workloads. If any fail, hold rollout.

Maya: Proposed rollout: alpha (3 customers) -> 10% internal canary -> 100% gradual. Alpha must pass Jorge's checks and have clear dashboards.

Raj: Implementation sketch: recommender service reads telemetry + eval baselines -> outputs ranked suggestions (batching configs, cacheable prefixes, quant profiles with simulated cost delta). Eval-alerter compares rolling eval to baseline and emits webhook events.

Lina: I'll build the eval harness and tune thresholds. Need sample prompt sets from pilot customers by Friday. Also want a false-positive mitigation plan (e.g., suppression window).

Maya: Action items: Raj design doc (Tue), Mateo flags/webhook plan (Wed), Priya console mockups (Wed), Lina eval harness + thresholds (Fri), Jorge acceptance tests (Fri). Add blockers now. :eyes:

Raj: blocking: kernel/quant perf data for accurate sim.

Mateo: blocking: customer webhooks need security review (HMAC).

Priya: no blockers.

Lina: nothing else.

Jorge: +1 to scope.

Maya: If everyone +1, we lock scope for the sprint. Thumbs? :thumbsup:

All: +1
